scope: R2-0 and R2-1 only; stop after Gate
sign: native decoder v flipped exactly once; CW-positive T
unit: official model or independent custom training seed; phases/checkpoints repeated within unit
selection: Reuse the fixed Rev02/03 official000–009 index cohort, not a random sample of official50; no phenotype re-selection.
bootstrap: 10000 whole-model row resamples; fixed phase columns retained; percentile95%; conditional robustness intervals, not official50 population intervals.
ICC_primary: ICC(A,1): balanced two-way mixed-effects, absolute agreement, single phase. Models are target units, the12 phases are fixed repeated conditions. Reliability conditional on the fixed grid and cohort; not random measurement-noise estimation.
ICC_secondary: ICC(C,1), same model, consistency; systematic phase means removed, cannot replace primary absolute agreement.
variance: Balanced centered sums of squares plus ANOVA moment estimates: sigma_model=(MS_model-MS_residual)/k; sigma_phase=(MS_phase-MS_residual)/n; residual=MS_residual. Retain negative estimates; residual conflates interaction with deterministic sampling/measurement differences. Also report observed variance of model phase means and mean within-model sample phase variance.
reversal: predicate on separately phase-averaged TO and TM
near_zero_policy: No new exclusion/floor for A sign. Exact sign including0; MAD/SD/IQR instead of dividing by near-zero mean A. Normalized spread uses positive paired G.
learning: Regular checkpoints only; common0–100k endpoints; adjacent pairs require1000-step difference. Late common80–100k is fixed sensitivity, not asserted plateau. Terminal last21 regular checkpoints at each unequal endpoint is additional descriptive window.
learning_metrics: Across-seed adjacent Pearson/Spearman/sign, per-seed adjacent changes and late sign stability; late odd/even checkpoint means correlated across seeds with no Spearman-Brown correction or iid-time p-value.
100k: Secondary two-sided exact binomial p under0.5 sign probability; no correction claimed for3 descriptive tests; report group-wise counts.
cross_condition: Only3 pairwise Spearman/Pearson relations on phase-average A, exploratory; no shuffle/physical/task score analyses.
gate: Holistic GO/REFINE/DROP based on primary ICC and CI, between/within variance, phase0-to-mean relation, sign consistency and both reversal definitions; no automatic single-cutoff decision. Selected-cohort and time-series restrictions apply.
